assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness
The patient has known atherosclerotic heart disease
The patient has nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
The diagnosis code I25.10 is used for atherosclerotic heart disease
The diagnosis code I34.0 is used for nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
The diagnosis code R42 is used for dizziness and giddiness
A 48-hour Holter monitor is used to evaluate for potential arrhythmias or ischemic changes
The Holter monitor is ordered to correlate the patient's dizziness and giddiness with possible cardiac events
The CPT code for the Holter monitor is 93226
The claim was denied for the 48-hour Holter monitoring study, CPT code 93226
The denial is based on reason code PR-204
No payment will be issued for the Holter monitor procedure
